title: Extension of the Construction Period — Construction Loans Terms
content:
The construction period of Construction Loans may be extended at the member's request, a limited number of times, on the following terms.

## Terms

1. At the member's request the construction period may be extended by the product's extension length in months, up to the product's maximum number of extensions.
2. An extension request must be registered at least the product's extension request lead time in calendar days before the construction end date, counted backwards from the end date with the end date as day 0.
3. An extension requires that no interest bill is past due and that an inspection shows progress since the previous draw; it carries a fee of the product's extension fee percentage of the commitment, rounded to cents.
4. A project with no draw or inspection progress for the product's stalled project period in days, or one that cannot be completed within the last available extension, is referred to a loan officer.

## Lead time (term 2)

- The construction end date is the one on the association's record of that construction loan; the comparison is with the date the request is registered.
- Counting runs backwards from the end date, which is day 0; the day before it is day 1, and so on.
- The request meets term 2 when it is registered on the day whose count equals the lead time, or on any earlier day. A request registered on a day whose count is smaller than the lead time does not meet term 2.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical lead time of 30 days, construction end date 30 June):* 31 May is day 30, so a request registered on 31 May meets term 2. 1 June is day 29, so a request registered on 1 June does not.

## Effect of an extension granted

- The construction end date moves to the previous end date plus the product's extension length in months.
- The count of extensions granted on the loan rises by one.
- A loan in active status becomes extended.
- The extension fee is assessed.

## Extension fee (hypothetical inputs)

The fee is the commitment multiplied by the product's extension fee percentage, rounded to the cent. On a commitment of USD 425,000 at an illustrative 0.125 percent, the fee is USD 531.25.

## Conditions of term 3 together

An extension requires both conditions at once: no interest bill on the loan past due, and an inspection showing progress since the previous draw.
